proposals.evidence: CDIAL 3677 *kṣāradhānikā explicitly gives Nepali kharāni ashes. These Danuwar, Majhi and Bote forms match the entire documented word, including -rani; inheritance versus regional Nepali transmission remains open. Exact survey form kʰarani is retained.
